test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A and B complete a work in 2 days. If A alone can do it in 4 days then, B alone can do 17-times of the same work in ______________(days).
solution:
**Given:**

A and B complete a work in 2 days.

A alone can do it in 4 days.

**Formula used:**

Work done by A in 1 day = 1/4

Work done by A and B in 1 day = 1/2

Work done by B in 1 day = Work done by A and B in 1 day - Work done by A in 1 day

**Calculation:**

Work done by A in 1 day = 1/4

Work done by A and B in 1 day = 1/2

⇒ Work done by B in 1 day = 1/2 - 1/4 = 1/4

B alone can do 17 times of the same work in 17 × (1/ (1/4)) days = 68 days

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
